what: Solana mainnet RPC. Without it the app uses the public endpoint, which is rate-limited enough that sends time out — worst on Token-2022 transfers that also create the recipient's account.
The platform API, including its prefix — /_api for Goshen, not /api. Unset means no sign-in and the Vault only opens public links.
The domain the platform may name in a sign-in challenge. Must match the server's AUTH_DOMAIN exactly; a mismatch is refused on the phone and looks like sign-in quietly doing nothing.
The Goshen web app — the site, not the API. Unset leaves Marketplace and Issue a Key visibly disabled.
dApp connect. A default ships in walletconnect/config.ts, so this only overrides it — for a fork, a second deployment, or a rotation. The web app must use whichever id is active.
Solana devnet RPC. The public devnet endpoint is fine for testing.
Ethereum RPC. Falls back to a public node.
BSC RPC. Falls back to a public node.
Only if sign-in ever moves off the Vault's host. Falls back to EXPO_PUBLIC_VAULT_API.
Same, for the challenge domain. Falls back to EXPO_PUBLIC_VAULT_DOMAIN.
EVM transaction history on Home and Activity. One key covers every EVM chain. Unset simply hides EVM history.
Push notifications while the app is closed. Also needs a real build and an EAS projectId, so it cannot work under Expo Go. In-app receive alerts work without it.
A JSON list of known-bad addresses ({ solana: [], evm: [] }) fetched at startup and warned about before a send. Unset means the built-in list only.
Adds 0x liquidity to the swap comparison via your backend, so the key stays server-side. Preferred over the key below.
Same, with the key embedded in the app instead. A fallback; prefer the proxy.
Points the treasury view somewhere other than the real address built into config/treasury.ts. Normally blank.
A pre-set Squads v4 multisig. Normally blank — you connect one in-app and it stores on the device.
Sends the community swap fee to a wallet other than the treasury above. Blank keeps the two in agreement, which is the point.
The treasury's 0x address for EVM swap fees. Blank disables EVM fees entirely.
How much worse a treasury-pool XGO swap may price before the app routes elsewhere, in basis points. Default 150 (1.5%).
